messages:
Priya Singh: Heads-up — EdgeWorks SI reported telemetry drop after marketplace image v4.2. They started a private deploy and our metrics/trace exports stopped for their tenant at ~09:12 PST. Needs arch + rollback plan.
Tom Alvarez: Ah — do we know if it's exporter config or image change? any logs?
Priya Singh: Partner pasted this snippet from their fluent-forwarder: 
```
level=error msg=\"failed to push batch\" err=\"rpc error: code = Internal desc = failed to create stream\"
```
They also said only the private deploy (govcloud VPC) is affected, hosted customers fine.
Jared Cole: pinging eng-runtime and eng-ml infra. @eng-oncall-bot can you pull recent deploys for marketplace-image:edgeworks:v4.2 and show rollout targets?
eng-oncall-bot: Deploy log for marketplace-image:edgeworks:v4.2 -> rolled out to 3 envs: staging (09:02), prod-hosted (09:05), prod-private-edgeworks (09:10). Canary showed no errors until private-only exporter config used.
Aisha Patel: Likely config leak: private deployes use our STATS_PROXY endpoint that needs mutual TLS to KMS cert. Could be cert rotation earlier today. @Tom any recent cert rotations on govcloud?
Tom Alvarez: We rotated KMS proxy cert at 08:50 for govcloud to address renewal. Ops notes said 'zero-downtime' but maybe the SI image pins older CA bundle.
Priya Singh: EdgeWorks confirms they pin CA in image and didn't pick up new chain. Their ops can't quickly rebuild image. They asked for a bridgeback to keep telemetry flowing while they rework image.
Jared Cole: Short term mitigation options:
- Route their telemetry to hosted relay (bypass mutual TLS) — requires network whitelist and consent.
- Temporarily re-issue previous cert (rollback) on STATS_PROXY for that tenant only.
- Feature flag to disable exporter in their private cluster (loses telemetry).
Which is fastest?
Tom Alvarez: Fastest is per-tenant rollback of cert chain if infra supports it. I can attempt but need approval from security. Backup: route to hosted relay with IP allowlist — will require partner firewall change.
Aisha Patel: Security ok to issue short-lived cross-signed cert for rollback window (30m) if scope limited and logged. I'll approve if we scope to tenant:edgeworks and timebox it.
Priya Singh: EdgeWorks accepts timeboxed rollback. They want <30m window. Also asked for a runbook of steps so their on-call can follow.
Jared Cole: Plan: 1) Tom issues cross-signed cert and applies to STATS_PROXY for tenant edgeworks only (09:45 ETA) 2) Validate telemetry flows (10:00) 3) Partner to rebuild image with updated CA and deploy 4) Rotate to new cert chain and revoke temporary cert (timebox 30m). I'll coordinate with partner.
Tom Alvarez: Starting cert issuance. Posting command for audit: 
```
# generate cross-signed cert (internal tooling)
redwood-certctl issue --tenant edgeworks --purpose stats-proxy --ttl 30m --reason "temp rollback for marketplace v4.2 CA mismatch"
```
I'll attach CA fingerprint in ticket.
eng-oncall-bot: Action logged: cert_issue request by Tom Alvarez for tenant edgeworks at 1719034500.
Priya Singh: Partner confirms telemetry resumed after 3m of applying cert. They see traces and metrics backfilled. :thumbsup:
Aisha Patel: Security note: we must add this case to postmortem for cert rollout communication and update marketplace onboarding doc to indicate CA pinning risks.
Jared Cole: Agreed. I'll open a short retro with EdgeWorks and eng-runtime to cover: (1) onboarding checklist update (2) image CA pin detection in CI (3) per-tenant rollback automation.
Tom Alvarez: Marking follow-ups: ticket #INT-4421 for retro, and #INFRA-7787 for automation.
Priya Singh: Thanks team — closing thread once ticket links are in customer-facing note. EdgeWorks wants a short writeup for their CSM.
Jared Cole: I'll draft quick note and share in #partnerships when ready.
Priya Singh: Awesome — appreciate the fast turnaround. :relieved:
